question: Can category-specific public requests improve all five target scenarios without new GPS information at a measured service cost?
planner: Greedy uncovered fraction per category, public catalogue only, deterministic tie order; also run until no gain for a full-cover diagnostic
candidate_locations: Largest strongly connected public road component, mapped through coordinate-to-road server snapping
coverage_target: Every publicly reachable POI across all road states, not only evaluation journey top-k
cost_accounting: Category-coordinate requests, distinct coordinates, reply POI slots and canonical JSON request/response bodies; 30 category requests are NOT 5 distinct coordinates. Equal response_L. All six category types requested independently of user interest.
privacy_scope: Conditional on public region/catalogue/request clock, fixed public requests are independent of private GPS; no guarantee for timing, session endpoints, identity, category selection or clicks. Prior-only attackers need not have zero Hit.
certificate: If every reachable POI belongs to at least one requested static top-L list, every currently available reachable POI appears in the union of live responses. Static road distance and stable tie order are required.
evaluation_scope: Existing expanded development, 15 A/B/C cases, no independent confirmation. No new SUMO trips. No claim of novelty for greedy set cover or superiority to bulk.
freeze_policy: Save plans before reading private evaluation traces or scoring availability; retain both variants and all probability/seed results. Do not replace the current method without a complete readout.
